fails_if: the LISA reader checks only a keyed text row's first cell, so a section heading with an added qualifier (or a renamed heading) passes as the observed layout
note: The hardest form of the keyed-text-row check: the heading text is intact and only another cell of its row changed. The change-section parametrization (a renamed heading in Individ årsoberoende!A30) is the same check on the first cell, the easy twin.
